title: Kerala Parippu Curry
description: Creamy moong dal cooked with turmeric and ground coconut, tempered in coconut oil, the Kerala sadya starter.
steps: Dry roast the moong dal in a pan for 3 minutes until fragrant, then wash and pressure-cook with turmeric, salt and 2.5 cups of water for 3 whistles.
Mash the dal lightly with a spoon.
Grind the grated coconut, cumin seeds, green chilli and garlic to a coarse paste with a splash of water.
Stir the coconut paste into the dal and simmer on low heat for 5 minutes without letting it boil hard; add water if too thick.
Heat the coconut oil, crackle the mustard seeds, then add dried red chilli, shallots and curry leaves and fry until the shallots are golden.
Pour the tempering over the parippu and serve with rice and a spoon of ghee.
